description: The SKE spec leaves `kubeconfig` on the CreateKubeconfig response as a plain string, but the operation returns an admin kubeconfig holding credentials for the cluster (spec summary: 'Create an admin kubeconfig'). STACKIT's own Terraform provider marks the same value `Sensitive: true` (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/ske/kubeconfig/resource.go, read 2026-11-01). Mark it sensitive so it stays Redacted in logs and spans. GetLoginKubeconfig and GetIDPKubeconfig use their own shapes and hold no credentials per the spec, so they stay plain.
